definitions.explanation: The act of affirming or confirming something as true or valid.

examples.japanese: ⟦{彼|かれ}→彼：01292_kare⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{意見|いけん}→意見：01303_iken⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧{肯定|こうてい}⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧。
{肯定|こうてい}⟦{的|てき}→〜的：09839_teki⟧⟦な→な：09497_na⟧⟦{返事|へんじ}→返事：00844_henji⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦もらった→もらう：00520_morau⟧。
⟦{自己|じこ}→自己：23357_jiko⟧{肯定|こうてい}{感|かん}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{大切|たいせつ}→大切：01456_taisetsu⟧⟦だ→だ：09496_da⟧。

notes:
{肯定|こうてい} means affirming something as true, correct, or valid. It functions as a noun and as a ⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧ verb.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {肯定|こうてい}⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧: to affirm, approve
- {肯定|こうてい}⟦{的|てき}→〜的：09839_teki⟧: affirmative, positive (as na-adjective)
- ⟦{自己|じこ}→自己：23357_jiko⟧{肯定|こうてい}{感|かん}: self-affirmation, self-esteem
- {肯定|こうてい}⟦{文|ぶん}→文：03716_bun⟧: affirmative sentence (grammar term)

SIMILAR WORDS:
- {肯定|こうてい}: affirmation (accepting as true)
- ⟦{否定|ひてい}→否定：03707_hitei⟧: negation, denial (rejecting as false)

USAGE:
Common in formal discussions, psychology, and grammar. ⟦{自己|じこ}→自己：23357_jiko⟧{肯定|こうてい}{感|かん} (self-esteem/self-affirmation) has become a widely discussed concept in education and mental health contexts.
